# 10 best free official AI learning platforms and roadmaps for 2026

(Zero-cost learning options) (2026 edition)

You can build a strong AI skill set in 2026 without paying for expensive bootcamps, subscriptions, or university courses.

The best approach is to combine\:

- **AI fundamentals\:** Understand AI, machine learning and generative AI.
- **Practical AI skills\:** Learn prompting, ChatGPT, Claude and AI productivity.
- **Technical skills\:** Learn Python, machine learning, LLMs and deep learning.
- **Advanced development\:** Build AI agents, RAG applications and real-world projects.

One important distinction: free courses don't always mean free certificates, cloud computing, API usage or hands-on labs. I've separated those costs rather than treating every free trial as a free course.

## 1\. The 10 platforms worth bookmarking

These are official provider, university or research-organization learning resources—not third-party course aggregators.

![OpenAI Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZKuFZijNv7RyKaCojK27xXmJ5w2K5PRqWF1ClwDn9vDjTboEUGBKRlfXoF7SNLxTfO4sTxF2VgGhIy8m0q1JKhKQChRbAEXZIwgg0pJCBbZQwbhPZTr5zpzYFhVCWE2cZA6Any6Sc-R_ZDa2eqHLzYWSwwOvPgvjSvdSo4nSjNNguBgMz_1z9UyEELvmoHWi?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. OpenAI Academy**

(Free courses and badges)

- Learn: AI foundations, prompting, workflows, agents, RAG and AI leadership.
- Best starting point: AI Foundations (about 70 minutes).
- Best for: Practical AI users, professionals and aspiring AI builders.

Official resources: [OpenAI Academy courses](https://academy.openai.com/public/courses?utm_source=chatgpt.com) · [AI Foundations](https://academy.openai.com/public/courses/ai-foundations-dnq5w?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2\. Google for Developers**

(Free learning materials)

- Learn: Machine learning, neural networks, LLMs, embeddings and ML fairness.
- Best starting point: Machine Learning Crash Course.
- Best for: Understanding how AI models actually work.

Official resources: [Google ML Crash Course](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course?utm_source=chatgpt.com) · [Google foundational courses](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/foundational-courses?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3\. Microsoft Learn**

(Free learning paths)

- Learn: Generative AI, Copilot, Azure AI, AI agents and responsible AI.
- Best starting point: AI Concepts for Developers and Technology Professionals.
- Best for: AI engineering and enterprise applications.

Official resources: [AI concepts learning path](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/paths/ai-concepts?utm_source=chatgpt.com) · [Microsoft training catalog](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/?tab=tab-learn-for-free&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Bull Theory (@BullTheoryio) on X](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ZZ1-wZbEarQ8SJtagWd5F63k0JqMXvtpuAA8wqPiPXCumbCmRwX1w7cMnhVSCY1RAKuEbyURpJg4GxgiyxPt7lXcygPbwJv68FhJug16CNfu3w38VpRnUWN9Lt2mImXwz4n41AosPQbK_QDsF1QxWBb9q_ZBLQvReQ8MIMC0d4byDYevjYNEgEYkcoCTs8iz?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Anthropic Academy**

(Free courses and certificates)

- Learn: AI fluency, Claude, effective prompting, responsible AI and API development.
- Best starting point: AI Fluency: Framework and Foundations.
- Best for: Learning to collaborate effectively with AI.

Official resource: [Anthropic AI Fluency course](https://anthropic.skilljar.com/ai-fluency-framework-foundations?via=free&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![IBM UK Newsroom - Announcements](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/KkeEtgFHlsKkonw46x-hPyWq9U8JgrlthqVrSSX7IMzwKkKTg9HpoDHCFWHJQhBTiMhRiKRToAzOyrSTyZ59NgMKKCaMUasFa0sUQg3AOTGokc7rkFGDw54Md7RlxrGuPXEVE5QU8eHPDSGhJaU8Og3YT_H0oekuEjEeTGCWpkrZUOdzSmVH67JWN58C6ewp?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. IBM SkillsBuild**

(100% free learning)

- Learn: AI fundamentals, generative AI, chatbots, AI ethics and data skills.
- Best starting point: AI Literacy.
- Best for: Beginners and career changers.
- Extra: Selected learning programs offer digital credentials.

Official resources: [IBM SkillsBuild](https://www.skillsbuild.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) · [AI learning catalog](https://skillsbuild.org/university/students?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![How can I use the Kaggle API for my projects?](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/3LmQn9DT3e5PuqCQ2X2CY6fviSIK22O9a432Z0h9nxA-dg99tcIRC1F6REKF4M9M-hXYdBOGL7FV_vwvky0e6Rxm9iga9B8q98AxzxxN9H_jV7y7H277uGa2-FTzL48fvFs5oqp3-4qLN-U90YHB_Z0hECZW4cBUNlBzCdOmxK2_40mFt_0180-CnN7ixyUC?purpose=fullsize)

**6\. Kaggle Learn**

(Free courses and certificates)

- Learn: Python, pandas, machine learning, deep learning and model evaluation.
- Best starting point: Python → Intro to Machine Learning.
- Best for: Learning by writing and running code.

Official resource: [Kaggle Learn courses](https://www.kaggle.com/learn?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![MTEB Leaderboard - a Hugging Face Space by mteb](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nP45bNKoNAfRJn1iLvlrdhxoplnVbtVUBRsIVFNPHwBwAYYJJrCma2JQNyah7U87woWJeBKz8hhb74zHFLNzUplQRD2v95D01KiVSSwIN__n_2Ffy20O34YejaKUfR1PwCicvlm_jk8ce-65lRh7jfLMaDEb8eAKoNyDJhQGoXMtejKCR4HLrX7qXJSAVFbn?purpose=fullsize)

**7\. Hugging Face**

(Free open courses)

- Learn: Transformers, NLP, LLMs, datasets, AI agents and model development.
- Best starting point: Hugging Face LLM Course.
- Advanced option: AI Agents Course.
- Best for: Open-source AI developers.

Official resources: [Hugging Face LLM Course](https://huggingface.co/docs/course/chapter1/1?utm_source=chatgpt.com) · [AI Agents Course](https://huggingface.co/learn/agents-course/en/unit0/introduction?trk=public_post_comment-text&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Ivymind](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/P9uB7gGTkc6sDOdfiR-O3dXTqtDWKA55IQLhIFtlr2aHgtk2y5VxsPkB8RU5eVcfLNWm5gDF189bFCKuXAYbE1Y_egqfy6vl9ClhYj339RaCMgbDa-T8bpVx4y5AcLociLQrRddpYcPx0kQBFtTBnJYCNUMfC_otjPq0exH70Msgu6YvoJdsmpLHsCy59-I7?purpose=fullsize)

**8\. Harvard University**

(Free OpenCourseWare)

- Learn: Search algorithms, knowledge representation, optimization, machine learning and neural networks.
- Best starting point: CS50's Introduction to AI with Python.
- Best for: Building a rigorous computer science foundation.
- Prerequisite: Python experience or CS50x.

Official resources: [Harvard CS50 AI](https://cs50.harvard.edu/ai/?hl=en-US&utm_source=chatgpt.com) · [Free CS50 certificate requirements](https://cs50.harvard.edu/ai/certificate/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![GitHub - fastai/nbdev-vscode](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/qOIwkm8CzO0VNQogWy-j8PWT47FAxvjR08KOaTZgZ_uj46exGPWP-Tq9MkrKmWzmZBkJ__fzKnPV9kaLln6Qz_97J83hIaUh0JDd93v_Rn0hwwTrNaLX7TNOTsoKUDTF1RfxZZWVW3XtckLfd1A2XT_NsMzj5wHB9qaZhZIqp7PpOCiIkeU2dW0wxEul73JK?purpose=fullsize)

**9\. fast.ai**

(Completely free course)

- Learn: Practical deep learning, computer vision, NLP and model deployment.
- Best starting point: Practical Deep Learning for Coders.
- Best for: People who want to build actual deep learning applications.
- Prerequisite: Some coding experience.

Official resource: [fast.ai Practical Deep Learning](https://course.fast.ai/index.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Researcher in Computer Science - Computer Science: 533840](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EN3I7Mf0cvEm6yVZ5rKlOijNkHgLr4_AJ4X7ymRGufbmuB9AqxHa_FCe4mco8o2pftIL9mJBvBlyE3j1yAj9rajVtHUsKpQvGtp6kaTq2s4sDk7xbOZVsJSzAVl3n4oTNTgtRwXABT1zrF8ui_f0E5--zjqSiIngVoEY2qDp3JfzlMRnAC4_5MEem90QdehQ?purpose=fullsize)

**10\. Elements of AI – University of Helsinki**

(Free course and certificate option)

- Learn: AI fundamentals, neural networks, machine learning and AI's societal impact.
- Best starting point: Introduction to AI.
- Best for: Complete beginners, including non-programmers.

Official resource: [Elements of AI](https://www.elementsofai.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 2\. Recommended learning roadmap: beginner to AI developer

Rather than studying all 10 platforms simultaneously, follow this sequence.

## A 12-week zero-cost AI roadmap

Suggested schedule · 5–8 hours per week

1. **Weeks 1–2: AI literacy and foundations**
   
   Study\:
   
   - Elements of AI
   - OpenAI Academy – AI Foundations
   - Anthropic – AI Fluency
   
   Outcome: Understand AI, LLMs, prompting, limitations and responsible AI use.
2. **Weeks 3–4: Python and data science**
   
   Study\:
   
   - Kaggle Python
   - Kaggle Pandas
   - Kaggle Intro to Machine Learning
   
   Outcome: Write Python code and work with datasets.
3. **Weeks 5–6: Machine learning**
   
   Study\:
   
   - Google Machine Learning Crash Course
   - Microsoft AI Concepts
   - IBM AI Literacy
   
   Outcome: Understand model training, evaluation, neural networks and ML workflows.
4. **Weeks 7–8: Deep learning and LLMs**
   
   Study\:
   
   - fast.ai Practical Deep Learning
   - Hugging Face LLM Course
   - Harvard CS50 AI (start if you have sufficient Python skills)
   
   Outcome: Understand transformers, deep learning and model development.
5. **Weeks 9–10: Generative AI and AI agents**
   
   Study\:
   
   - OpenAI Academy – Build with AI
   - Hugging Face AI Agents Course
   - Microsoft Generative AI learning paths
   
   Outcome: Build an AI assistant, experiment with RAG and understand agent workflows.
6. **Weeks 11–12: Projects and portfolio**
   
   Build three projects\:
   
   - An AI document question-answering assistant.
   - A customer support chatbot.
   - An AI research assistant with retrieval and citations.
   
   Outcome: Have demonstrable projects to showcase on GitHub and your résumé.

## 3\. Which platforms are best for each AI career goal?

| Your goal | Best platforms |
|--------|--------|
| AI beginner | Elements of AI, OpenAI |
| AI productivity | OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft |
| Machine learning engineer | Google, Kaggle, Harvard |
| Deep learning engineer | fast.ai, Harvard |
| Generative AI developer | Hugging Face, Microsoft |
| AI agent developer | OpenAI, Hugging Face |
| Enterprise AI | IBM, Microsoft |
| Open-source AI developer | Hugging Face, Kaggle |


## 4\. Important: what does zero cost actually mean?

These distinctions matter when planning your education.

| Resource | Free learning | Certificate |
|--------|--------|--------|
| OpenAI Academy | Yes | Free course badges |
| Anthropic Academy | Yes | Free completion certificate |
| Google ML Crash Course | Yes | No general professional certificate |
| Microsoft Learn | Yes | Learning achievements free; exams may cost |
| IBM SkillsBuild | Yes | Selected free digital credentials |
| Kaggle | Yes | Free course certificates |
| Hugging Face | Yes | Course-dependent credentials |
| Harvard CS50 AI | Yes | Free CS50 certificate subject to requirements |
| fast.ai | Yes | No standard course certificate |
| Elements of AI | Yes | Free certificate subject to completion criteria |


**Watch out for hidden costs\:**

- Cloud GPU usage may cost money.
- API calls may exceed free quotas.
- Professional certification exams are often paid.
- Some platforms charge for certificates, advanced labs or subscriptions.

For example, Harvard explicitly offers a free CS50 certificate if you meet its project requirements, while its verified edX certificate is a separate paid option. [cs50.harvard.edu](https://cs50.harvard.edu/ai/certificate/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cs50.harvard.edu](https://cs50.harvard.edu/ai/faqs/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) Kaggle also explicitly advertises no-cost courses and certificates. [www.kaggle.com](https://www.kaggle.com/learn?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Official resource: [Elements of AI](https://www.elementsofai.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## 2\. Recommended learning roadmap: beginner to AI developer

Rather than studying all 10 platforms simultaneously, follow this sequence.

## A 12-week zero-cost AI roadmap

Suggested schedule · 5–8 hours per week

1. **Weeks 1–2: AI literacy and foundations**
   
   Study\:
   
   - Elements of AI
   - OpenAI Academy – AI Foundations
   - Anthropic – AI Fluency
   
   Outcome: Understand AI, LLMs, prompting, limitations and responsible AI use.
2. **Weeks 3–4: Python and data science**
   
   Study\:
   
   - Kaggle Python
   - Kaggle Pandas
   - Kaggle Intro to Machine Learning
   
   Outcome: Write Python code and work with datasets.
3. **Weeks 5–6: Machine learning**
   
   Study\:
   
   - Google Machine Learning Crash Course
   - Microsoft AI Concepts
   - IBM AI Literacy
   
   Outcome: Understand model training, evaluation, neural networks and ML workflows.
4. **Weeks 7–8: Deep learning and LLMs**
   
   Study\:
   
   - fast.ai Practical Deep Learning
   - Hugging Face LLM Course
   - Harvard CS50 AI (start if you have sufficient Python skills)
   
   Outcome: Understand transformers, deep learning and model development.
5. **Weeks 9–10: Generative AI and AI agents**
   
   Study\:
   
   - OpenAI Academy – Build with AI
   - Hugging Face AI Agents Course
   - Microsoft Generative AI learning paths
   
   Outcome: Build an AI assistant, experiment with RAG and understand agent workflows.
6. **Weeks 11–12: Projects and portfolio**
   
   Build three projects\:
   
   - An AI document question-answering assistant.
   - A customer support chatbot.
   - An AI research assistant with retrieval and citations.
   
   Outcome: Have demonstrable projects to showcase on GitHub and your résumé.

These distinctions matter when planning your education.

| Anthropic Academy | Yes | Free completion certificate |

| IBM SkillsBuild | Yes | Selected free digital credentials |
| Kaggle | Yes | Free course certificates |
| Hugging Face | Yes | Course-dependent credentials |

| fast.ai | Yes | No standard course certificate |

items.markdown:
**Watch out for hidden costs\:**

- Cloud GPU usage may cost money.
- API calls may exceed free quotas.
- Professional certification exams are often paid.
- Some platforms charge for certificates, advanced labs or subscriptions.

For example, Harvard explicitly offers a free CS50 certificate if you meet its project requirements, while its verified edX certificate is a separate paid option.
